title: Candidate location record
description: One row of the candidate place gazetteer. Fields marked network_layer are required for the sequence-and-connectivity test and are currently unpopulated across the whole table — see OPEN_QUESTIONS.md item 3.

place_id.description: Stable unique identifier. Never reused, never renumbered.

name.description: Place name as it appears in the primary source, unnormalised.

name_normalised.description: Uppercased, punctuation stripped. Derived, not authoritative.

initial.description: First letter of the place name. Matching is first-letter-only: 'Port Adelaide' has initial P, not A.

place_type.description: What kind of place this is. A locality and the station serving it are separate records.

coord_precision.description: How the coordinate was obtained. map_estimate means read off the 1938 sheet by eye.

population_1947.description: 1947 Commonwealth Census, Volume I Part VIII. Null where the place is not a census unit.

population_source_row.description: Census table and row reference, for reconciliation.

mode.description: network_layer. UNPOPULATED. Transport mode serving this place in 1948.

route_id.description: network_layer. UNPOPULATED. Route or line identifiers serving this place. A place on two routes carries both; a shared identifier between two places is a direct connection.

route_seq.description: network_layer. UNPOPULATED. Map of route_id to ordinal position along that route. Required for direction-of-travel reasoning.

service_from.description: network_layer. UNPOPULATED. Earliest confirmed service date, ISO 8601 or year. See the Queenstown problem, OPEN_QUESTIONS.md item 1.

service_to.description: network_layer. UNPOPULATED. Closure date. Null if still open in 1948.

service_confirmed.description: network_layer. True only where service_from is verified against a primary record. Default false.

source.description: Primary source for this record. For rail stations this is normally the 1938 SA Railways map, P.P. No. 47.

notes.description: Free text. Use for disagreements between sources and for anything load-bearing.

load_bearing.description: True where a downstream conclusion depends on this record being correct. Queenstown is the current example.
